content.short: Verafy provides a revenue verification layer on Cardano to bridge digital ads and accounting ledgers.
content.description: Verafy is an infrastructure project on Cardano dedicated to solving the transparency gap between digital advertising platforms and physical bank accounts. By utilizing deterministic entity resolution, the platform provides a 'Revenue Truth Layer' that verifies offline income against on-chain activity. Verafy allows agencies and operators to reconstruct their digital spend and verify deposits with high precision, ensuring that financial data is accurate and auditable. Its mission is to bring institutional-grade revenue verification to the decentralized and traditional business worlds.
content.meta: Verafy offers Cardano-based revenue verification for digital ad platforms and accounting ledgers. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
